name: global-law
description: Three skills that answer questions about the law of about 200 countries from the record itself, through the hosted Global law MCP server (free, no account or key): global-law reads any provision as in force on any date and names the law behind it; law-change-trace follows how a provision changed and which laws changed it; citation-check checks every legal citation in a text against the law in force on the right date. Every answer cites the official publisher's text and states where the record starts and ends.
